verdict.rationale: n8n documents a command line ("Use the command line", confirmed by the CLI probe) and a public n8n API. It self-hosts via Docker Compose or a one-line install script, and workflows can be triggered by webhooks. Community users report running scheduled and webhook-initiated workflows in production at high volume without the UI, so headless automation is clearly the core use. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline usage docs or examples, detail on which CLI commands execute workflows, a published OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
